# Changelog

All notable changes to this project are documented in this file.

## 1.0.0 - 2026-08-04

- Add motion-aware residual caching for MiniMax H3 joint video/audio denoising.
- Add an experimental batched-tile MiniMax H3 video VAE decoder.
- Add English and Simplified Chinese documentation with enabled/disabled comparisons.
- Add Comfy Registry metadata and publishing validation support.
